name: Caio Terra Guard Retention System
description: Caio Terra Online's public defense archive includes one-legged X against the toreando pass and half-guard recovery lessons.
summary: Caio Terra Online lists individual lessons on one-legged X against a toreando pass, half-guard recovery and a related half-guard Q&A.
overview: Caio Terra Online's defense archive includes guard-recovery material for two specific situations: one-legged X against a toreando pass, and half-guard recovery. A separate half-guard Q&A is also listed. These are individual lessons within the online library, whose full instructional videos require membership. This page covers those named subjects rather than attributing a complete guard-retention system to Caio Terra.
